text.en: Homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysts are just two names for the same thing, distinguished only by the specific chemical used -- in reality, the distinction is about phase: a homogeneous catalyst is in the same phase as the reactants (giving thorough contact but a hard separation problem afterward), while a heterogeneous catalyst is in a different phase (reaction confined to its surface, but trivially separable from the product) -- a genuinely different engineering tradeoff, not just a different chemical.
text.et: Homogeensed ja heterogeensed katalüsaatorid on lihtsalt kaks nimetust samale asjale, mida eristab ainult kasutatav konkreetne kemikaal -- tegelikult puudutab eristus faasi: homogeenne katalüsaator on reagentidega samas faasis (andes põhjaliku kontakti, kuid raske eraldusprobleemi pärast reaktsiooni), samas kui heterogeenne katalüsaator on erinevas faasis (reaktsioon on piiratud selle pinnaga, kuid triviaalselt eraldatav tootest) -- tõeliselt erinev inseneri kompromiss, mitte lihtsalt erinev kemikaal.
